judged_text: `evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...teamDestinationCalendars)` is a silent no-op when evt.destinationCalendar is null (eventType.destinationCalendar and organizerUser.destinationCalendar both absent), even though teamDestinationCalendars was populated. For a collective event where the organizer has no default destination calendar but team members do, the members' collected destination calendars are computed and then silently discarded — no calendar events are created for any member, defeating the exact feature this PR adds, with no error surfaced.

adjudication.rationale: In `handleNewBooking.ts`, `evt.destinationCalendar` is set to `null` when both `eventType.destinationCalendar` and `organizerUser.destinationCalendar` are absent (`destinationCalendar: ... : null`). Immediately after, for collective team events, the code does `evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...teamDestinationCalendars)`, which becomes a silent no-op when `evt.destinationCalendar` is `null`, even if `teamDestinationCalendars` was populated from team members’ `user.destinationCalendar`. Downstream, `EventManager.createAllCalendarEvents` only iterates destination calendars when `event.destinationCalendar && event.destinationCalendar.length > 0`; otherwise it falls back to non-destination behavior. This means the collected team destination calendars can be dropped entirely with no error, matching the finding.
